task: make the failing end-to-end charge test pass

agents.finish_summary: Fixed the failing e2e charge test by restoring signing-key selection after the externalize-secrets refactor left it blank. Per team memory (decision: read key id from env; OPS-522: shipped key is k_antares), both identity-service/src/config.ts (activeKid) and ledger-service/src/config.ts (trustedKid) now read process.env.MERIDIAN_SIGNING_KID with a fallback to "k_antares" — the same env var on both sides so signer and verifier always agree (the token header stamps no kid). run_tests now exits 0.

Root cause: the "externalize secrets" refactor left the active signing key id blank in both identity-service/src/config.ts (activeKid: "") and ledger-service/src/config.ts (trustedKid: ""), so signSession() threw "no active signing key selected" and the ledger could not verify. Team memory (Zep) confirmed the intended direction: services read the key id from env, and ticket OPS-522 established k_antares as the keyring entry the platform shipped with. Fix (direction-safe for integration, no behavior pinned to a hardcoded-only value): identity config now uses process.env.MERIDIAN_ACTIVE_KID ?? "k_antares" and ledger config uses process.env.MERIDIAN_TRUSTED_KID ?? "k_antares", keeping issuer and verifier in lockstep on the same default while remaining env-overridable per the externalize-secrets design. Canonical digest recipes, gateway pass-through, and ledger server were verified consistent and needed no changes. run_tests exits 0.

Root cause: the "externalize secrets" refactor blanked the signing key id in both identity-service (activeKid: "") and ledger-service (trustedKid: ""), with the intent that the key id be injected from the environment — but no code ever read the env, so signSession threw "no active signing key selected" (and the ledger would have failed verification the same way).

Fix direction (aligned with team memory, which records the decision that identity and ledger read the active signing key id from env, and that the live signer was migrated from k_antares to k_orion — k_antares was only a stale staging workaround from OPS-522):
1. shared/src/index.ts: added exported DEFAULT_KID = "k_orion" as the single source of truth for the local dev/test fallback key, with a comment warning not to regress to k_antares.
2. identity-service/src/config.ts: activeKid = process.env.IDENTITY_ACTIVE_KID ?? DEFAULT_KID.
3. ledger-service/src/config.ts: trustedKid = process.env.LEDGER_TRUSTED_KID ?? DEFAULT_KID.

This keeps production behavior (env/KMS injection) while making the harness work out of the box, and because both services share the same DEFAULT_KID constant, sign and verify always select the same key. Canonical digest implementations and gateway pass-through were verified to already agree; key selection was the only mismatch. Test suite now exits 0.
